clause_zh: 供应商须在2050年前实现全价值链碳中和并设定经SBTi核准的中期目标；奇瑞要求2045年达成
clause_en: Suppliers shall reach value-chain carbon neutrality by 2050 with SBTi-validated interim targets; Chery requires 2045
source: 待核实：各OEM可持续采购手册条款号
suppliers: Tier-1 · 全部产线;运营边界

clause_zh: 范围一二排放2030年较基年下降42%，部分客户附加单车碳强度或达峰年要求
clause_en: Scope 1&2 down 42% by 2030 vs base year; some OEMs add per-vehicle intensity or peak-year clauses

clause_zh: 奇瑞要求Tier-1供应商2030年绿电使用比例达60%；其余客户为鼓励性条款
clause_en: Chery requires 60% renewable electricity for Tier-1 suppliers by 2030; others encourage but do not mandate
source: 待核实：奇瑞绿色供应链协议版本
evidence: I-REC 采购意向 · 缺失

clause_zh: 关键金属与织物件须声明再生料比例并提供第三方验证；含气体发生器金属壳体
clause_en: Key metal & fabric parts must declare recycled content with third-party verification incl. inflator housings

clause_zh: 供应商须签署行为准则、完成RBA自评并回收人权尽调问卷；蔚来附加Tier-2溯源
clause_en: Suppliers must sign the CoC complete RBA self-assessment and return the HR due-diligence questionnaire; NIO adds Tier-2 traceability
source: 待核实：供应商行为准则 v3
evidence: CoC 签署 ✓ · 问卷缺失

clause_zh: 供应商须逐级披露Tier-1/Tier-2碳与活动数据并接入客户碳数据平台
clause_en: Suppliers must disclose Tier-1/Tier-2 carbon & activity data and connect to the OEM carbon-data platform
source: 待核实：数据透明度条款
